description.en: The Cameroon arm of The Navigators, an international Christian ministry that helps people grow in their faith through Life-to-Life discipleship: studying the Bible together, praying, and walking with others in everyday life.
description.fr: La branche camerounaise des Navigateurs, un ministère chrétien international qui aide chacun à grandir dans sa foi grâce à un discipulat de vie à vie : étude de la Bible, prière et accompagnement au quotidien.
